event_name: Document 42 Date 01 July 2018 Time 16:08 2018 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 28 June - 01 July 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 left the track when in front of car 33 and rejoined safely in the same position, after turn 3.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 27.3 (leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence including on-board cameras from the cars involved and the following cars, and concluded that car 7 rejoined the track safely, albeit at high speed. Both cars came close together however there was no contact. All Competitors are hereby reminded of their right to appeal certain
stewards: as set out in the International Sporting Code
title: Doc 42 2018 Austrian Grand Prix Decision Car 7 Turn 3 Incident
